item.title: Neural-Symbolic AI (1): Symbolic
item.description:
This post belong to series neural-symbolic AI

Materials: Notion page for GOAI

What is symbolic AI?

Symbolic Artificial Intelligence (A Good OldFashioned AI - GOAI) is the term for the collection of all methods in artificial intelligence research that are based on high-level “symbolic” (human-readable) representations of problems, logic and search. See Stefan Woltran slides

Symbolic AI is a whole difference approach from Machine Learning, it base on knowledge and logic instead of statistics and patterns.

item.title: Neural-Symbolic AI (2): The Math of Logic
item.description:
This post belong to series neural-symbolic AI

As mentioned in previous post, Symbolic AI work with symbols and logic instead of numbers, patterns and statistics. But how to represent knowledge? How to make inference in a logical way? That is where Propositional Logic and First-Order Predicate Logic come in handy. And to build up a Neural Networks, we need something that differentialable. Fuzzy Logic helps us to do this.

Propositional Logic

In propositional logic, propositions are connected by logical operators. The statements “the street is wet” and “it is raining” are propositions. These two propositions are called propositional atoms or atoms. Atoms refer to single relations and are the simplest statements.
